name: Valencia Street Circuit
notes: Valencia Street Circuit, Port of Valencia, 2008 to 2012 (clockwise, 25 turns). Not the Circuit Ricardo Tormo. Via route over the members of OSM relation 280461: the old track roads, the swing bridge section and the purpose built sections, now mostly service roads. The building and footpath members are not used. Two bridges close gaps where OSM has no road: through the roundabout at Turns 2 and 3 near the Grau station, and the Turn 25 hairpin onto the short pit straight. Traced 5257 m vs 5419 m. Start line on the pit straight between Turn 25 and Turn 1. One DRS zone as in 2012: from after Turn 10 along the kinked straight to the Turn 12 chicane. The harbour water is not drawn on the overview. Values from 2012 F1: race laps, pit lane loss and overtaking are approximate. tyre_wear_mult and the wet weather multiplier are first guesses and will be tuned. speed_scale is 1.0 until the lap time calibration against the 2012 pole. pole_side is the inside of the first corner (approximate).
